name: channel-2
title: OpenMSA v1.0 Alpha: Safe Decentralized Data Spaces in .NET
description:
This demo introduces OpenMSA, an open-source reference architecture for governed data spaces.

Watch to learn:
- Managed Space model and fixed global contract
- Asymmetric identity with JWT + JWKS
- Local policy engine with default deny
- Local index-based lookups (no raw folder enumeration)
- Write-only inbox for inbound deliveries

Repository:
https://github.com/surajkumar8642/openmsa

For developers: full .NET implementation + example API included.
